name: 01775 · Stow, MA
findings: ZIP 01775 (Stow) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01775 (Stow) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01775 (Stow) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
